page.title: 同格と挿入で説明を差し込む

analysis.summaryJa: 抽象名詞の内容をthat節で示す同格、名詞句の同格、関係節との違い、挿入表現を扱う。
grammarPoints: 関係代名詞thatは節内の要素を担う
人名・日付などの名詞同格
visualEvidence: 抽象名詞からthat節へつながる内容ラベル
完全な内容節と欠けのある関係節の対比
コンマ・ダッシュで同格を囲む図
本文へ補足カードを差し込む図
commonTraps: 関係節で不要な代名詞を重ねる
同格のコンマを片側だけに置く
挿入語で文の骨格を壊す

questions.prompt: The rumor ------- our downtown branch would close proved false.

choices.A: which

questions.translationJa: 中心街支店が閉店するといううわさは誤りでした。
questions.explanationJa: rumorの内容を完全なthat節が説明します。

questions.prompt: Management expressed the belief ------- flexible hours would improve retention.

choices.A: that

questions.translationJa: 柔軟な勤務時間が定着率を高めるという考えを経営陣は示しました。
questions.explanationJa: beliefの具体的内容をthat節で示します。

questions.prompt: I had a feeling ------- the client would request another revision.

choices.A: whose

questions.translationJa: 顧客が再修正を求めそうな気がしました。
questions.explanationJa: feelingの内容なので接続詞thatが適切です。

questions.prompt: The idea ------- we should move the display near the entrance was well received.

choices.A: which it

questions.translationJa: 展示を入口近くへ移すという案は好評でした。
questions.explanationJa: ideaと同格の内容節をthatで導きます。

questions.prompt: There is still hope ------- the delayed shipment will arrive today.

choices.A: that

questions.translationJa: 遅れた荷物が今日届く望みはまだあります。
questions.explanationJa: hopeの内容を表す完全な節をthatで続けます。

questions.prompt: The committee reached the conclusion ------- a second inspection was necessary.

choices.A: which

questions.translationJa: 委員会は再点検が必要だとの結論に達しました。
questions.explanationJa: conclusionの中身をthat節が説明します。

questions.prompt: The fact ------- the invoice was unsigned caused a payment delay.

choices.A: which it

questions.translationJa: 請求書に署名がないという事実が支払遅延を招きました。
questions.explanationJa: factの内容を同格のthat節で表します。

questions.prompt: The possibility ------- the venue may change is noted in the invitation.

choices.A: what

questions.translationJa: 会場が変更される可能性は招待状に記載されています。
questions.explanationJa: possibilityの内容をthat節が補います。

questions.prompt: The news ------- our bid had been accepted reached us this morning.

choices.A: who

questions.translationJa: 当社の入札が採用されたとの知らせが今朝届きました。
questions.explanationJa: newsの内容を完全なthat節で示します。

questions.prompt: The warehouse, ------- was renovated last year, now uses less energy.

choices.A: which

questions.translationJa: 昨年改装されたその倉庫は、今では消費エネルギーが少なくなりました。
questions.explanationJa: 先行詞warehouseを説明する非制限用法なのでwhichです。
questions.focus: 同格節と関係節の識別

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing the content of a rumor.

choices.A: We heard a rumor which the supplier would relocate.
choices.B: We heard a rumor that the supplier would relocate.
choices.C: We heard a rumor that would the supplier relocate.
choices.D: We heard a rumor what the supplier would relocate.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先が移転するといううわさを聞きました。
questions.explanationJa: that以下はrumorの内容を表す平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence containing a relative clause.

choices.A: The supplier that it opened the new depot is based in Osaka.
choices.B: The supplier the fact that opened the new depot is based in Osaka.
choices.C: The supplier that the new depot opened is based in Osaka.
choices.D: The supplier that opened the new depot is based in Osaka.

questions.translationJa: 新しい配送所を開設した仕入先は大阪に拠点があります。
questions.explanationJa: thatはopenedの主語となる関係代名詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a content clause.

choices.A: The proposal that we extend support hours will be discussed tomorrow.
choices.B: The proposal that extend we support hours will be discussed tomorrow.
choices.C: The proposal which we extend support hours it will be discussed tomorrow.
choices.D: The proposal what we extend support hours will be discussed tomorrow.

questions.translationJa: サポート時間を延長するという提案は明日議論されます。
questions.explanationJa: that節はproposalの内容で、主語weを含む完全な節です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with an appositive name.

choices.A: Our logistics director Ms. Vega, will visit the depot.
choices.B: Our logistics director, Ms. Vega will, visit the depot.
choices.C: Our logistics director, Ms. Vega, will visit the depot.
choices.D: Our logistics director is Ms. Vega, will visit the depot.

questions.translationJa: 物流部長のベガさんが配送所を訪問します。
questions.explanationJa: 役職と人名が同一人物なので人名をコンマで囲みます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a parenthetical opinion.

choices.A: The revised plan, is in my view, financially sound.
choices.B: The revised plan is in, my view financially sound.
choices.C: The revised plan is, in my viewed, financially sound.
choices.D: The revised plan is, in my view, financially sound.

questions.translationJa: 改訂計画は、私の見方では、財務的に妥当です。
questions.explanationJa: in my viewは挿入句として両側をコンマで区切ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a stated fact.

choices.A: We cannot ignore the fact which three units failed inspection.
choices.B: We cannot ignore the fact that three units failed inspection.
choices.C: We cannot ignore the fact that did three units fail inspection.
choices.D: We cannot ignore the fact what three units failed inspection.

questions.translationJa: 3台が検査に不合格だった事実を無視できません。
questions.explanationJa: factの内容には平叙文語順のthat節を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence distinguishing content from description.

choices.A: The report that had risen sales surprised the board.
choices.B: The report which sales had risen it surprised the board.
choices.C: The report that sales had risen surprised the board.
choices.D: The report what sales had risen surprised the board.

questions.translationJa: 売上が伸びたという報告は取締役会を驚かせました。
questions.explanationJa: that節はreportの内容で、sales had risenは完全な節です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a nonrestrictive insertion.

choices.A: The new scanner, according to the technician, is easier to maintain.
choices.B: The new scanner according to, the technician is easier to maintain.
choices.C: The new scanner, according the technician, is easier to maintain.
choices.D: The new scanner is, according to the technician is, easier to maintain.

questions.translationJa: 技術者によれば、新しいスキャナーは保守しやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: according to the technicianをコンマで挿入します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a specific office.

choices.A: The office, that handles refunds is on the second floor.
choices.B: The office that it handles refunds is on the second floor.
choices.C: The office the fact that handles refunds is on the second floor.
choices.D: The office that handles refunds is on the second floor.

questions.translationJa: 返金を扱う事務所は2階にあります。
questions.explanationJa: 必要な限定情報なのでthat関係節をコンマなしで置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence presenting a conclusion.

choices.A: We reached the conclusion which the schedule was unrealistic.
choices.B: We reached the conclusion that the schedule was unrealistic.
choices.C: We reached the conclusion that was the schedule unrealistic.
choices.D: We reached the conclusion what the schedule was unrealistic.

questions.translationJa: その日程は非現実的だとの結論に達しました。
questions.explanationJa: conclusionの中身をthat＋平叙文語順で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “There is a possibility that the flight will be delayed.”

choices.A: The flight has already been canceled.

questions.translationJa: その便は遅れる可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: possibility thatはmayで同じ可能性を表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The news that the factory had reopened pleased local suppliers.”

choices.A: Local suppliers reopened the factory themselves.
choices.B: Local suppliers were pleased to learn that the factory had reopened.
choices.C: The factory closed after suppliers received the news.
choices.D: Suppliers were unhappy about the reopening.

questions.translationJa: 工場再開の知らせを地元仕入先は喜びました。
questions.explanationJa: newsの内容と喜んだ主体を保つ言い換えです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Our auditor, Mr. Kim, requested the records.”

choices.A: Mr. Kim requested an auditor to prepare the records.
choices.B: Our auditor and Mr. Kim requested separate records.
choices.C: Mr. Kim, who is our auditor, requested the records.
choices.D: Mr. Kim became our auditor after the request.

questions.translationJa: 当社の監査担当キムさんが記録を求めました。
questions.explanationJa: 同格名詞句をwho節へ展開して同一人物を表す。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The claim that the product is waterproof has not been verified.”

choices.A: It has not been confirmed that the product is waterproof.
choices.B: The product has been confirmed to work only underwater.
choices.C: The company withdrew every product claim.
choices.D: The waterproof product has already passed all tests.

questions.translationJa: その製品が防水だということは確認されていません。
questions.explanationJa: claimの内容を形式主語構文へ移して同じ未確認情報を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The proposal is, in my opinion, too costly.”

choices.A: I prepared a less costly proposal.
choices.B: I think the proposal is too costly.
choices.C: The proposal is inexpensive according to everyone.
choices.D: I have not reviewed the proposal's cost.

questions.translationJa: その提案は高すぎると私は思います。
questions.explanationJa: 挿入句in my opinionをI think節へ展開しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The office that processes permits closes at five.”

choices.A: Every office stops processing permits permanently at five.
choices.B: Permits close the office at five.
choices.C: The office processes permits only after five.
choices.D: The permit-processing office closes at five.

questions.translationJa: 許可証処理窓口は5時に閉まります。
questions.explanationJa: 関係節の機能を複合修飾語へ置き換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We share the belief that customer trust must come first.”

choices.A: We believe customer trust must be our first priority.
choices.B: We believe customers should trust only the first proposal.
choices.C: We disagree about whether trust matters.
choices.D: Our customers ranked us first without explanation.

questions.translationJa: 顧客の信頼を最優先すべきだと私たちは考えます。
questions.explanationJa: beliefの内容を動詞believeの目的節へ変えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The deadline—September 30—remains unchanged.”

choices.A: The deadline was moved from September 30.
choices.B: September 30 is the first day of the project.
choices.C: The deadline, which is September 30, has not changed.

questions.translationJa: 締切の9月30日は変更されていません。
questions.explanationJa: ダッシュ内の同格情報をwhich isで展開しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The assumption that demand would remain stable was incorrect.”

choices.A: It was incorrect to assume that demand would remain stable.
choices.B: Demand remained stable exactly as expected.
choices.C: No assumption about demand was made.
choices.D: Demand was incorrect because it increased steadily.

questions.translationJa: 需要が安定するとの想定は誤りでした。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞assumptionを動詞assumeへ変えて内容を保ちます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The north entrance, incidentally, is now open.”

choices.A: The north entrance opened because of an incident.
choices.B: Only the south entrance is open now.
choices.C: The north entrance will close immediately.
choices.D: By the way, the north entrance is now open.

questions.translationJa: ちなみに、北口は現在開いています。
questions.explanationJa: incidentallyとBy the wayは補足を差し込む同種の表現です。

questions.prompt: A message circulated this morning. The rumor ------- the CEO had resigned was soon denied.

choices.A: which

questions.translationJa: 今朝、CEO辞任のうわさが広まりましたが、すぐ否定されました。
questions.explanationJa: rumorの内容をthat節で示します。

questions.prompt: The team favors remote training. Its belief ------- employees learn better at their own pace shaped the plan.

choices.A: what

questions.translationJa: 自分のペースのほうが学びやすいという考えが計画に影響しました。
questions.explanationJa: beliefの中身を完全なthat節が説明します。

questions.prompt: The reception desk has moved. The desk ------- used to be near the entrance is now beside the elevators.

choices.A: the fact that

questions.translationJa: 以前入口近くにあった受付は今エレベーター横です。
questions.explanationJa: thatはused to beの主語となる関係代名詞です。

questions.prompt: Our newest board member, -------, previously led the finance division.

choices.A: Dr. Singh

questions.translationJa: 新任取締役のシン博士は以前財務部門を率いていました。
questions.explanationJa: 人名が役職を言い換える同格です。

questions.prompt: The route is shorter. It is, -------, more expensive because of tolls.

choices.A: because

questions.translationJa: その経路は短いですが、通行料のため高くなります。
questions.explanationJa: 短さと費用を対比する挿入副詞howeverです。

questions.prompt: The committee accepted the recommendation ------- all visitor badges be replaced.

choices.A: which

questions.translationJa: 委員会は来訪者用バッジを全交換する勧告を受け入れました。
questions.explanationJa: recommendationの内容をthat節で示します。

questions.prompt: The delivery date—-------—is printed on every invoice.

choices.A: April 18

questions.translationJa: 配送日、つまり4月18日は各請求書に印刷されています。
questions.explanationJa: 日付がdelivery dateを説明する同格です。

questions.prompt: The new policy, -------, should reduce approval time.

choices.A: because it

questions.translationJa: 私たちの見方では、新方針は承認時間を短縮するはずです。
questions.explanationJa: 話者の判断を挿入するin our viewが自然です。

questions.prompt: We received confirmation ------- the payment had cleared.

choices.A: what

questions.translationJa: 支払いが決済されたとの確認を受けました。
questions.explanationJa: confirmationの具体的内容をthat節が補います。

questions.prompt: The branch ------- opened last month has already exceeded its sales target.

choices.A: the idea that

questions.translationJa: 先月開店した支店はすでに売上目標を超えました。
questions.explanationJa: thatはopenedの主語となりbranchを限定します。
